features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, smoothed by adding 1.0 to the absolute value of V2 to prevent division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized relative measure between the first two features, helping linear models capture interaction effects without complex non-linear kernels.

features.name: v3_v4_diff
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct linear projection of the contrast between V3 and V4, which is highly suitable for linear SVM margins.

features.name: v1_v2_v3_composite
features.description: Weighted sum of the first three features, emphasizing V1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates the primary features into a single continuous severity measure, reducing dimensionality and noise for the linear classifier.

features.name: v4_v5_magnitude
features.description: Euclidean-like magnitude of the higher-index features V4 and V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the combined intensity of V4 and V5 in a non-linear way, exposing a new linearly separable boundary based on magnitude.

features.name: v1_v2_max
features.description: The maximum value between V1 and V2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Extracts the dominant signal between the first two features, providing a piecewise linear feature useful for margin boundaries.

features.name: v1_v2_min
features.description: The minimum value between V1 and V2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Extracts the baseline or weaker signal between the first two features, complementing the maximum feature for linear models.

features.name: global_mean_value
features.description: The average value across all five features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a global continuous measure of the row's overall magnitude, serving as a stable baseline feature.

features.name: v1_v5_diff
features.description: Difference between the first and last features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the spread or contrast between the extremes of the feature set, offering a strong linear projection.

features.name: total_energy_proxy
features.description: Sum of the squares of all five features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents the total variance or energy of the observation, allowing the linear SVM to separate based on overall intensity.

features.name: spectral_tilt_proxy
features.description: Ratio of the energy in V4 and V5 to the energy in V1 and V2, smoothed by 1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the balance between higher-index and lower-index feature energies, providing a normalized continuous score.

features.name: v2_v3_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V2 to V3, smoothed by adding 1.0 to the absolute value of V3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative proportion between V2 and V3, useful for identifying specific patterns in the middle features.

features.name: acoustic_signal_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of the acoustic signal's complexity based on the distribution and magnitude of the 5 features, returning a continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic properties of the signal that might not be easily expressed through simple arithmetic combinations, providing a linearly separable feature for the SVM.
